data.narrative:
Epsilon3, a Series A space and aerospace company founded by Laura Crabtree and Max Mednik, has raised $19M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 5 public equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private firms across the same sector and stage spectrum, including Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Planet Labs.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $19M raised proxy, implying a $38M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector peers at Series A/B stages—Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B), Aalyria ($1.3B), and Starcloud ($1.1B)—yields a median valuation of $1.3B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring using the sector's 24.4x P/S median across six tickers cannot be applied due to unavailable revenue disclosure.

Triangulation across the two applicable methods supports a range of $32M to $1.5B, with a median of $669M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression conservatively values only capital deployed, while peer-median likely incorporates market multiples and momentum in frontier aerospace. The appropriate valuation depends critically on Epsilon3's revenue traction, capital efficiency, and technical differentiation relative to the peer set—none of which are quantifiable from current data.
